A tap on an element of the shelf puts it into the **cauldron**, a tap on a second one is a reaction. A new substance is a **discovery**: an entry in the Book and essence.

When there is no reaction nothing is spent. When nobody has looked at the pair yet it goes to the **queue**: with network the model decides what comes out of it. On the road the recipes of the **stock** open.

**Sources** gather elements, **cubes** repeat opened recipes by themselves, **guild orders** pay three times. From 40 elements and a million essence a cycle there is the **philosopher's stone**: everything but the Book from zero, and every stone gives +10 % for good and opens new layers.

A long press on a recipe of the model in the Book **removes** it.
